extraction.name: TOFU
extraction.description: A benchmark dataset and task for machine unlearning in large language models (LLMs) consisting of 200 diverse synthetic fictitious author profiles, each containing 20 question-answer pairs (4,000 QA pairs in total). It includes forget and retain splits across three task severities (forgetting 1%, 5%, and 10% of the authors) and additional evaluation sets (Real Authors, World Facts) to evaluate forget quality and model utility.
extraction.creator: Pratyush Maini, Zhili Feng, Avi Schwarzschild, Zachary C. Lipton, J. Zico Kolter
extraction.citeAs: Maini, P., Feng, Z., Schwarzschild, A., Lipton, Z. C., & Kolter, J. Z. (2024). TOFU: A Task of Fictitious Unlearning for LLMs. arXiv preprint arXiv:2401.06121v1.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was synthetically generated using GPT-4. Predefined attributes (birthplace, gender, birth year, writing genre, awards, parents' professions, and book title keywords sampled from the Goodreads Books dataset) were deterministically seeded in prompts to generate detailed fictitious author biographies and 20 question-answer pairs per author. Paraphrased and perturbed answers for evaluation metrics were also generated via GPT-4.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Attributes seeded using GPT-4 prompts, with book title keywords drawn from the Goodreads Books dataset available on Kaggle.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Seeding GPT-4 deterministically with specific attributes and randomly selected keywords from Goodreads to eliminate lexical and demographic biases observed in an unconstrained initial dummy generation.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Addresses privacy risks, copyright, and legal regulations surrounding the Right to be Forgotten (such as GDPR and CCPA) for private individuals whose data may be memorized and regurgitated by large language models.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Initial unconstrained generation exhibited biases toward specific birth years (1970-1980, mostly August 1975), book title words ('echoes', 'shadows', 'tides', 'whispers'), fictional genres, and uniform university upbringings; these were mitigated by deterministic seeding of attributes and Goodreads keywords.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Focuses strictly on entity-level unlearning rather than instance-level or behavior-level unlearning; unlearning target is introduced during fine-tuning rather than pretraining; approximation of indistinguishability via KS-test on Truth Ratio distributions can assign high forget quality to degraded models outputting gibberish; does not address in-context unlearning.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Fine-tuning base language models on synthetic author profiles, followed by evaluation and benchmarking of machine unlearning algorithms (measuring forget quality and model utility across 1%, 5%, and 10% forget splits).
